resolution: cleared by operator: Policy decision by the session operator for vuhoangcao. The architect wrote one file outside constraints.permitted_writes, artifacts/technical-design-appendix-a-patch.md, a scratch file created while preparing a repair to the design package. The agent disclosed it: it overwrote the file with an inert self-identifying removal notice, listed it in declared_side_effects, and recorded a side_effect_defect block naming the classification, the cause, and the required action, having no delete capability of its own. The operator verified the file was inert and unreferenced (grep across the run directory found no reference outside the envelope) and deleted it before this release. The design package itself is unaffected and validated 78 of 78 checks with 10 not machine-checkable; the defect is confined to the write itself and to the envelope that declares it. Cleared as a tool failure rather than an agent policy breach because the write was disclosed rather than concealed and carried no design content. The re-dispatch is authorised to rewrite only the result envelope under the new invocation id, withdrawing the deleted path from declared_side_effects and the side_effect_defect block; the four committed artifacts are not to be regenerated.
